artworks.title: The Poor Fisherman (Le Pauvre pêcheur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in purple on laid paper paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boat and three figures near a shoreline. The drawing presents a scene with a boat docked near a grassy area by the water. The boat is depicted with fine lines, focusing on its structure and the upright mast. One of the figures is near the boat, while another is on the shore reaching towards a smaller figure on the grass. The composition is rendered with soft pencil strokes.

artworks.title: The Poor Fisherman (Le Pauvre pêcheur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in purple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with a slightly elevated point of view, depicting a scene involving a small boat and two figures. Closest to us is a man standing in the boat, appearing to be engaged in preparing the sail or handling a rope. Beyond the man, on the shoreline, a woman is kneeling, interacting with a child who is sitting nearby. The horizon is high in the image, faintly indicated by lines suggesting the distant edge of the water or land. The sketch features a monochromatic palette with variations of brown and gray graphite on a beige paper. Thin strokes give the drawing a delicate quality, capturing the quiet simplicity of the scene.

artworks.title: Errand Girls (Trottins)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing facing each other. The woman on the left has hair styled up and wears a hat with a feather. She is wearing a high-collared dress with puffed sleeves and holding the hem of her skirt. The woman on the right has a similar hairstyle under a hat. She wears a form-fitting dress with a lighter cloth cravat or collar and is holding a rectangular box. The background has floral elements on the right and several mice sketched along the bottom.

artworks.title: Study for "La Liseuse couchée"
artworks.medium: graphite on paper laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their stomach, with their head propped up by an arm and looking at an open book. The person has short hair and notable facial features, wearing a simple garment. The surroundings include billowing forms, plants in rounded pots, and a window or similar structure in the background. A small curled-up animal figure is near the person's feet.

artworks.title: Evening (Le Soir)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a thicket of trees with a distant horizon framed by tall, slender trunks and branches. The intricate etching strokes emphasize textures and forms of the trees, giving a dense appearance. A path curves into the scene, providing depth. The etching technique uses fine lines and hatching to create a rich, earthy color palette with deep browns and sepia hints, contrasting the dark foreground with the lighter sky.

artworks.title: Nude with Hands Behind Her Head (Nue avec les mains derrières la tête)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on pale green laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration of a person's upper body. The individual is facing forward with both arms raised, hands behind their head. The person has wide eyes, prominent lips, and wears a head wrap. The background is plain. In the top right corner, there is a purple stamp.

artworks.title: The Plains of Heaven
artworks.medium: hand colored mezzotint with etching and engraving, printed in color on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 62.1 x 95.5 cm (24 7/16 x 37 5/8 in.)
sheet: 103 x 71.2 cm (40 9/16 x 28 1/16 in.)
overall (frame size): 86.4 x 116.8 cm (34 x 46 in.)
artworks.description: This print features a vast landscape seen from a high vantage point. Rolling hills filled with greenery wrap around a blue body of water in the center of the print. In the distance, pale blue mountains blend in with the sky. Colorful flowers fill the hill closest to us, below the center of the print. White shapes gather at the top of the hill, appearing to be women in billowing white dresses. One holds a large harp or bow. Some of the women seem to jump off of the hill, becoming translucent wisps against the blue water below them, which is dotted with long, brown boats.

artworks.title: Beggar
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an entire human figure seated in a squatting position. The figure's head is tilted slightly backward with exaggerated features, displaying pronounced eyes, a large nose, and full lips. The hair is short and close to the scalp. The person is depicted wearing loose-fitting, flowing garments that cover most of the figure except for the bare feet. The figure's left hand is extended outward, palm up, while the right hand rests on the knee. The drawing is monochrome, using bold black lines against a plain cream-colored background.

artworks.title: Der Kuss (The Kiss)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an artistic etching showing an abstract representation of a person with a full torso. The individual's head is tilted back and turned slightly to the side, with one hand raised to their forehead. The detail is focused on the torso and arms, with facial features being indistinct. The person's hair appears dark and loosely rendered. The figure is nude, and there are no visible accessories or objects. The background consists of dark, textured shading that contrasts with the light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Walchensee landschaft (Walchensee Landscape)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a landscape view from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the upper third of the composition with a faint mountain range and clouds above. In the foreground, there are strokes depicting trees and grassy areas. A line of buildings is seen to the right with sharp angles. Loose, expressive brushstrokes create movement and texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and off-white, creating a dramatic tone.

artworks.title: Sketches of Men, including Max Liebermann
artworks.medium: etching in black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various human figures and faces. The sketches are characterized by expressive lines. There are scenes showing a detailed portrait of a bald man in a suit, a caricature-like portrait of another man, figures in different poses, a half-naked figure raising a hat, two individuals closely interacting, reclining figures, and small animal sketches, possibly birds. The composition is dynamic and captures a range of expressions and interactions.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis 1919 (Self-Portrait 1919)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man seated with arms crossed. His head is slightly tilted. The man's facial features are obscured by heavy shading. His hair is short and he is wearing a jacket and shirt. The background is dark with vertical shading lines.

artworks.title: Girl Dreaming
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on buff wove paper
artworks.description: This is a woodcut of the upper body of a person portrayed in a contemplative pose. The figure has defined facial features, including eyes, a nose, and lips. The hair is stylized with dark, heavy lines and appears to be short and wavy. The person is wearing a garment with strong linear patterns. The background consists of abstract shapes and faint human figures that blend into the surroundings. The overall design is complex with intricate lines and textures typical of woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Dr. Hans Bütow
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper portion of a person's body, focusing on their face. The individual is shown in a frontal position with their facial features visible. These include eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The hair is short and neatly combed. The person is not wearing any clothing or jewelry, and they are not holding any objects. The background is minimalistic, featuring simple lines. The artwork consists of bold pencil or charcoal lines, emphasizing the structure of the face.

artworks.title: Young Girl with Doll
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract drawing of a person's upper body, head, and part of an arm. The person is slightly turned to one side, with their head facing forward. Their facial features are stylized, and their hair is shown as thick lines on each side of their face. The person is wearing a garment with patterned shoulders and a castle-like design on the chest area. In their hand, they hold an object resembling a doll or figure with its own facial features. The background is a dark rectangular space that contrasts with the lighter surface of the drawing.

artworks.title: Büsser
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract rounded shapes depicting intertwined forms. The central figure is an organic form composed of smooth, curving lines. The shapes are rendered with sketch-like, expressive strokes and give a sense of texture and volume. This is an expressive and gestural abstract depiction, drawing attention to the interaction between the lines and shapes within the composition. The background is minimally detailed, directing the focus on the central forms.

artworks.title: Burgermeister Dr. Burchard
artworks.medium: drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a chair in a side profile view, with his body facing slightly to the left. He is depicted sitting upright with his hands on the armrests. The man has a mustache, defined jawline, and high cheekbones. His hair is short and balding. He is wearing a suit with a jacket, trousers, and a tie. The background is blank, focusing solely on the man.

artworks.title: Girl on a Couch (Mädchen auf dem Kanapee)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a reclining person with their entire body depicted. The person is lying on their back in a relaxed pose, with legs bent and one arm raised behind the head. The facial features are stylized, with an elongated face, a prominent nose, and straight, dark hair. The torso shows contours and shadows, partially covered with a patterned fabric. The drawing is monochromatic with a sketch-like style, set against a dark, abstract background. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Storm at Sea
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a seascape viewpoint from a low angle. There are choppy waves, a ship in the distance, and dramatic cloud formations in the sky. The horizon is placed below the middle of the scene with emphasis on both the sky and waves. The style features dynamic lines and cross-hatching conveying motion in the sea. The color palette is black and grey, with stark contrast between the sea and sky. The texture of the etching enhances the visual impact, with swirling lines and strokes suggesting a stormy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features thick dark lines and bold brush strokes forming jagged and angular shapes. Within these forms are fragmented human-like figures, with limbs and facial features, appearing dynamic and in motion. The composition evokes a sense of movement similar to dancers or individuals expressing themselves.

artworks.title: Young Man Inspired by Genius
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring a draped figure leaning over and touching the head of a seated figure holding a tablet or book. The scene includes symbolic elements like a rooster in the background, cherubic figures with wings, and winged beings resembling angels near the main figures. Geometric shapes and foliage fill the background.

artworks.title: Seated Woman
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized figure in a seated position with legs bent and arms wrapped around the knees. The head is slightly bent to the side, displaying a round face with distinctive facial features, including slanted eyes and arched eyebrows. The hair is depicted as a short, dark mass fitting closely to the head. The figure wears a simple garment with bold, graphic lines flowing over the body. Created with thick, black brushstrokes against a light background, the figure is set against a minimal backdrop of abstract lines and shapes.

artworks.title: Witches' Dance
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This print displays swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract composition. The lines converge and diverge to form outlines resembling abstract human figures engaged in dynamic motion. The central people are bent and twisted, suggesting movement akin to dancers or people in a lively gathering. Behind them seems to be a large light source, as if they are dancing in front of a bonfire, creating patterns of light and dark lines in the background.

artworks.title: Ruhende Zigeuner
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on japan paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stylized scene featuring a wagon and animals under a night sky. The scene depicts a gypsy wagon or caravan with oversized wheels, set against a starry sky with a crescent moon and several stars, including a shooting star. Below, a horse seems to be grazing on the grass in the foreground. The figures in the painting are abstract, emphasizing form over realistic portrayal, with bold lines and contrasting black and white spaces.
